dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I've realized we're in a bit of a tricky situation here.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: If we go out, we won't have time to watch that film we rented.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: But if we stay in and watch the film, we won't have time to go out.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Yeah, well... pretty smart for a five-year-old.
